# Research Review Checklist

- [ ] The computational question is distinct from a biological claim.
- [ ] Inputs, commit, environment, seed, and configuration are recorded.
- [ ] The measured endpoint is defined and units are stated.
- [ ] Unsupported or unavailable endpoints remain explicitly unsupported.
- [ ] No post-hoc parameter tuning is hidden in the workflow.
- [ ] Evidence JSON and generated artifacts have a traceable path.
- [ ] External literature is identified separately from simulation output.
- [ ] The manuscript/release boundary is preserved.
